decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on established pharmacy channels and costs little to carry, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises doubts, so the option is held while its value is watched.
The skin and hair supplement no longer appeared on the website after 2019, which suggests demand did not materialize, and abandoning it frees resources for stronger lines.
The joint supplement benefits from the established Trivital brand at low carrying cost, so despite weaker online visibility the option is still worth holding a little longer.
The OTC triptan is a strategically valuable entry into consumer health whose uncertainty has not resolved, with no archived pages to judge it, so keeping the option open is sensible.
